entries.33631e2fd6294c41: A business that conducts corporate investment and concessions. entries.fea2d8a214792d01: Consolidated revenues for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥3,330,831 million, up 16% from the previous fiscal year. As factors for the increase, an increase in gains and losses on investment securities and dividends received, due to recording fund valuation gains at a U.S. subsidiary and valuation gains from the transfer of shares of Greenko Energy Holdings, and increases in life insurance premiums and investment income and in service revenues are cited. Of the 10 segments, the largest revenue is Insurance at ¥643,045 million (up 24%), followed by Real Estate at ¥530,901 million (up 7%) and Corporate Financial Services and Maintenance Leasing at ¥487,842 million (up 6%). ORIX USA was ¥272,219 million, up 77% from the previous fiscal year. Revenues consist of items of different character by business, such as lease rentals (operating lease revenues), finance revenues such as interest on loans, revenues from sales of real estate and goods, service revenues, and life insurance premiums.
entries.ff847cb733e3a32b: Net profit attributable to owners of the company for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥447,265 million, up 27% from ¥351,630 million in the previous fiscal year. In the same period, revenues increased by 16% and operating expenses increased by 13%. Operating expenses are explained as having increased because life insurance costs and other expenses increased. Because the structure holds a large amount of loans, real estate, lease assets, and insurance investment assets, funding procurement and estimates of the value of money lent and assets held (allowance for credit losses, fair value measurement, impairment of long-lived assets, etc.) are cited as important accounting estimates that affect profit and loss.
